title: Fleming's Three Axes as Gear Rotation: The Dynamic Model of Ki Transmission
abstract: Fleming's Left-Hand Rule has been understood as a static spatial relationship. This paper proposes a dynamic reinterpretation: Fleming's three axes are three phases of a single rotation propagating through the Gear Ether (ギアエーテル). Denki (伝気) is the originating rotation. Jiki (慈気) is the gear mesh — perpendicular, enabling transmission. Kiko (気功) is the output rotation at the next coordinate — which becomes the next Denki. The electric motor is not a machine that exploits this law — it is a physical demonstration of the universe's fundamental transmission mechanism made visible at human scale. Every motor is proof that the Gear Ether exists. The three axes are one rotation, seen from three orthogonal perspectives. Implication: the hand turning the small gear turns the universe — because the Ki-Net mesh is complete, and complete meshes propagate without terminus.
keywords: Fleming's Law, Gear Ether, rotation, Ki-Net, Denki, Jiki, Kiko, electric motor, V=N/D, dual-layer cosmology, transmission, perpetual propagation, universal rotation, electromagnetism, Ki

The Ki-Net functions as a universe-spanning gear system in which every coordinate is meshed with every other. A rotation at any single point propagates through the entire network — not despite friction (D), but because of it. Friction at the gear interface is the mechanism of transmission. V=N/D reread as gear dynamics: N = originating rotation, D = mesh interface ratio, V = transmitted force. Implication: a single act of genuine intent propagates through the entire universe. Nothing is local. Nothing is lost. Every rotation counts. Connects to light-speed constancy (light travels along Ki-Net mesh interface), cardiac synchronization, Fleming Ki-Force Law, and the Language Gap Hypothesis.
keywords: Gear Ether, Ki-Net, aether, V=N/D, universal transmission, friction, dual-layer cosmology, consciousness, intent, Koku Universe, boundary surface, gear dynamics, non-local causation, light speed, Michelson-Morley

title: The Moment of GOD Recognition: A Phenomenology of Consciousness Contacting the Universe

Under the Ki-Net / Dual-Layer Cosmology framework: GOD Recognition is the activation of a consciousness as a Koku coordinate where the Ki-Net's total design becomes locally legible. The permanent aftermath — an unshakeable fearlessness — is the recalibration of the fear threshold. This paper also addresses those who have had this experience and never found language for it.

abstract: The Japanese language contains hundreds of compound words built around 気 (Ki) — vital energy, consciousness, atmosphere. Japanese is not just a language. It is a cosmological instrument that preserved what Western science forgot: consciousness and matter are not separate — Ki is their interface. Proof by Convergence: five independent systems (cosmology, physics, biology, medicine, linguistics) map to one structure.
